title: Learning to Sleep Better
sentences: I used to stay up late every night, scrolling through my phone in bed.
Although I felt tired in the morning, I couldn't seem to break the habit.
A friend suggested that I try turning off my screen an hour before bed.
At first, I found it really hard, and I kept reaching for my phone out of habit.
However, after a couple of weeks, I noticed that I was falling asleep much faster.
I've also started going for a short walk in the evening, which helps me relax.
Since I began sleeping better, I've had more energy during the day.
I still get tempted to check my messages before sleeping, but I usually resist now.
My mood has improved too, and I feel calmer when small problems come up.
If I have a bad night, I try not to worry, because one night won't ruin everything.
Changing this habit wasn't easy, but it was definitely worth the effort.
